options.name: message
options.description: Message text. Empty hides the message and unlinks the target.

options.name: tone
options.description: Visual tone and icon. Only 'error' sets aria-invalid on the target.

options.name: for
options.description: Control described by the message: receives the host id in aria-describedby while a message is shown, and aria-invalid for errors.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ error: IconRef; warning: IconRef; success: IconRef; info: IconRef }>

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; receives an id if it has none.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Set the message and optionally the tone.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Hide the message and unlink the target.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; throws before changing anything on an invalid tone or target.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Unlink the target, remove rendering and classes, and unhide the host.

cssClasses.name: aui-validation-message
cssClasses.description: Host (also used by the built-in field error element).
